description: JavaScript class definition for StockAnalytics report in ERPNext, extending StockGridReport, handling data preparation, filtering, and display of stock analytics.

classes.name: StockAnalytics
classes.description: Class for managing stock analytics report, including data setup, filtering, and group updates.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the StockAnalytics report with configuration options.

methods.name: setup_columns
methods.description: Defines and sets up the columns for the report.

methods.name: setup_filters
methods.description: Configures filters for the report and sets up change triggers.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares the data for display, including tree structure and resetting values.

methods.name: prepare_balances
methods.description: Calculates opening, closing balances, and updates item data based on stock ledger entries.

methods.name: update_groups
methods.description: Updates group totals based on individual item data.

methods.name: show_stock_ledger
methods.description: Navigates to the stock ledger report for a specific item.
